From time to time, thieves rob the bank in Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel or Venore and the banker stops working. Find the thief hiding near the city, kill him, pick up the {item:Bag With Stolen Gold} and return it to the banker before Server Save. You receive 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and the achievement **Honest Finder** (and **Goldhunter** after five bags).
A Tibian bank is robbed and cannot operate until the stolen money is returned.
Banker of the robbed city (e.g. Naji, Thais)
The Mini World Change must be active (it can happen every hour, counting from server start-up).
recommended for the swamp on the way to Shadowthorn (Venore)
Return the bag **before the next Server Save**: after that the event ends and the bag disappears from your inventory.
As long as the bag is not returned, the bank services of the robbed city are unavailable.
1. Find out which bank was robbed
Check whether the event is active

When the event starts, one of these messages appears: *"Several banks in major coastal towns are being robbed! The thieves are still on the loose!"* The {wiki:Towncryer} announces the robbery and the Adventurer's Board in the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild} also mentions it. If neither talks about the robbery, the event has not happened yet or the gold has already been returned.
Talk to the bankers in the four possible cities. The robbed banker will not serve you and tells you where the thief fled:
Dwarves who fled to the mines (Dwarf Mines)
Each city has its thief in a fixed hideout. Go to the location of the robbed city.

Go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just northwest of Thais's north gate, and go down the temple's stairs and holes to the indicated point (floor -4). To leave, go back the same way and climb the holes with the {item:Rope}. Kill {creature:Jesse the Wicked}. Along the way there are {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}.

The thief fled to the Kazordoon mines. The {wiki:Dwarf Mines} are west of and under Kazordoon and have 6 entrances to the surface; go in and go down to the indicated point (floor -4). Kill {creature:Elvira Hammerthrust}. To leave, go back the same way to the entrance you came in by (bring a {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel}). Along the way there are {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}, {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} and {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}.

The {wiki:Ghostlands} are **west** of Carlin. On the surface there are several holes that go down to the caves; go down to the indicated point (floor -2) and kill {creature:Robby the Reckless}. To leave, climb back up the hole you came down with the {item:Rope}. Along the way there are {creature:Rat|Rats}, {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} and {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}.
In one of the Ghostlands caves there are stairs that go down to a room with a {creature:Giant Spider} and that close behind you: there, the hole is the only way out. Do not go down there.

{wiki:Shadowthorn} is an elf camp **southeast** of Venore. Leave Venore through the **east exit** and cross the swamp following the route in the image ({item:Machete} and {item:Shovel} help, but are not mandatory). Kill {creature:Mornenion}. To return, take the same route in reverse to Venore. Along the way there are {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Marsh Stalker|Marsh Stalkers}, {creature:Swampling|Swamplings}, {creature:Elf|Elves}, {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts} and {creature:Firestarter|Firestarters}.
Fastest route from Venore to Shadowthorn
Open the thief's corpse and take the {item:Bag With Stolen Gold}.
During {wiki:Double Loot Events} or with a {item:Wealth Duplex} potion you can loot more than one bag.

Go back to the banker of the robbed city with the bag in your inventory. Say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. You receive 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, the achievement **Honest Finder** and the bank works again.
You must return the bag before the next Server Save, otherwise the bag disappears and you lose the reward.
Several bags in the same event

If two or more bags were looted in the same event, several players can return them to the banker, but they have to do it **at the same time**: synchronise your messages to the NPC. That way the achievement progress advances by one for each player.
Return five bags (in different events) to earn the achievement **Goldhunter**.
It is not known exactly how often the event happens; it is known that it has a chance of happening every hour, counting from the server start-up time.
After the gold is returned, the banker serves normally again (e.g. {npc:Eva} says the thief was caught).
